source.paper: unknown Srinagar daily (Greater Kashmir or similar)

summary: A grid of boxed public notices, nearly all INVITATION CANCELLED wedding notices from the July 2016 unrest. Every box repeats the same structure: heavy condensed caps head, justified body, bold centred name block.

headers.notes: Heavy condensed grotesque caps filling the box width; a variant reverses it out of black.

units.example: We regret to inform that due to prevailing situation, the marriage ceremony of our daughter... Mr. Ajaz Ahmad Shah / H No 129 Shadab Lane...
units.notes: Body in regular sans, justified; sign-off name in bold, address and phone below, centred.
Double-height head: INVITATION in huge white caps on black, CANCELLED in spaced caps below; phone numbers in black tags.
Reverse head in a Clarendon-like serif, serif body: shows mixing within one grid.

type.look: Clarendon-style bold serif head on one notice

notes: Repetition with tiny variation is the whole look: one template, different head weights and reverses.
Content is tied to a real crisis; use the layout, not the copy.
